name: Palco Metals Limited
about: Palco Metals Limited, through its subsidiary, Palco Recycle Industries Limited, engages in the manufacture and sale of aluminum wire and deoxident in India. It offers aluminum ingots, notch bars, shots, and alloys, as well as wire rods and cables. The company was formerly known as Premier die casting & Eng. Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Palco Metals Limited in July 2001. Palco Metals Limited was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
